_comment: The motions she can play. Drop a Mixamo .fbx next to this file and add a line;
nothing else changes. Anything listed but missing is skipped with a note, so
this file can describe the whole wish-list while only some of it exists.
Download settings that matter, from Mixamo's download dialog:
Format  FBX Binary (.fbx)      Skin  Without Skin      FPS  30
In Place  TICKED for anything that travels (walk, run) — the code moves her,
which is far easier to steer than baked root motion.
role:  idle       a resting loop; one of these is always playing
gesture    plays once over the idle, then hands back
pose       a loop she stays in until told otherwise (sitting)
transition plays once to get into or out of a pose
mood:  which feelings this suits. Empty means any. The scheduler will not
pick a cheerful skip while she is apologising.
Waiting.fbx and Bored.fbx are listed but NOT yet downloaded — they are what
the 'waiting' mood will use, and they will start working the moment the files
land here. Nothing else has to change.
Also present but deliberately unlisted: 'Standing Up.fbx' is Mixamo's
getting-up-off-the-FLOOR animation, 343 frames of it. The chair transitions
are Stand To Sit / Sit To Stand below.
